name: Vicky
summary:
Vicky is an AI-native simulation platform for clinical training, giving students a safe and repeatable environment to practice clinical workflows, interact with medical equipment and build experience through realistic training scenarios.

After signing in with an account provided by their institution, users can access the training labs assigned to their organization.
Each lab can include guided clinical scenarios, interactive medical equipment, educational prompts, knowledge checks and step-by-step assessme
